=== README head
# XHarness SuperAgent

基于 Rust / XHarness 的主动式 Agent 产品开发项目，参考 DeepSeek SuperAgent
的产品逻辑：接收 GitHub/飞书事件，评估与授权，创建和执行任务，再将结果回复给用户。

**状态：开发版。已有正式入口和 GitHub/飞书文本的离线协议整链路，另完成了 GitHub 的真实模型/文件/回帖及受限 Draft PR 交付验收；
不是完整可部署的 SuperAgent 替代品，也不宣称已完整业务对齐。**

## 复刻什么

对齐任务、授权、角色、工具、会话控制、回复、配置和恢复等产品逻辑；
不复刻 JavaScript 语言运行时，不要求极端字符串/历史日期的全域等价。
详见 [产品范围](docs/superagent/product-scope.md)。

## 已实现的组件

- Rust 领域模型、策略与 27 个业务命令。
- SQLite 事务、配置历史、迁移、持久化 Effects 和幂等 Outbox。
- XHarness 原生会话/JSONL 接入组件、队列/followup/steer/inject、观察与关闭。
- 部分 Prompt/skills、输入准备、重试健康和崩溃恢复组件。
- 固定原版源码及组件差分验证设施。
- Application/Native 装配及20个角色应用工具注册（主角色14个、Worker6个）。
  名字已注册不代表所有分支完成；正式入口离线协议夹具可实际启动 Worker 写文件
  并经 Outbox 回复，不冒充真实外部服务或完整产品验收。
- GitHub Source 的通知/评论/PR/CI 轮询、稳定事件和 marker 回复库已接到 Native；
  [接入进展与验证边界](docs/superagent/business-github.md)。

- 正式 `xharness-superagent --config ... [--check | --once]` 入口及实际 OpenAI 兼容
  HTTP/SSE → Native → CodingToolBundle → GitHub marker 回复闭环。
  [配置、权限和验证边界](docs/superagent/business-entry.md)；外部服务由明确的

ci.yml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  rust:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      # Git preserves executable bits, not the pinned archive's group-write bits.
      # This existing helper verifies every source hash before restoring modes.
      - run: node conformance/restore-reference-modes.mjs
      - run: node conformance/verify-reference.mjs
      - run: node conformance/verify-upstream.mjs
      - run: node conformance/business/verify-tool-manifest.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/host-input-observer.test.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/flush-observation.test.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/product-cargo-overlay.test.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/business-word-cargo-overlay.test.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/feishu-cargo-overlay.test.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/messages-cargo-overlay.test.mjs
      - run: node --test conformance/business/management-cargo-overlay.test.mjs
      - run: python3 scripts/superagent/test-state-bundle.py
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix conformance
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/github-source-oracle.mjs --check
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/feishu-source-oracle.mjs --check
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/feishu-read-oracle.mjs --check
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/github-read-oracle.mjs --check
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/github-context-oracle.mjs --check
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/word-limits-oracle.mjs --check
      - run: node --experimental-transform-types conformance/business/transcript-oracle.mjs --check
      # coding-tools 的 glob/grep 真实依赖 ripgrep;2026-10 起 GitHub 镜像不再预装
      # bubblewrap:沙箱测试真实依赖它。装着才验证得了 bash 越界与断网两条断言,
      # 没装会走 require_bwrap! 跳过 —— 那等于没覆盖,所以 CI 必须装上。
      - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep bubblewrap
      - if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install ripgrep
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo fmt --check --all
      - run: cargo check --locked --workspace --all-targets --features xharness-superagent/conformance
      - run: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --features xharness-superagent/conformance -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo test --locked --workspace --all-targets --features xharness-superagent/conformance
      # 进程组回收测试依赖真实子进程生命周期,必须单线程跑(沿袭上游纪律)
      - run: cargo test --locked -p xharness-process --test process dropping_ -- --test-threads=1
